text: ＊は　＊で　すばやさが　あがった！

structure.jp: すばやさが　あがった！

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing can show what caused the result. ＊で = 'because of ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜は〜が
patterns.span: ＊は　＊で　すばやさが　あがった
patterns.explanation: は names who we are talking about, and が names the part of them that the rest describes. ＊は　すばやさが　あがった = '＊'s Speed rose'.
